note: M4.1 game values, decided without the owner (asleep; listed for his review): a round passing within 4 m of a man adds up to 0.3 suppression (heavier rounds more: square root of energy over 1,700 J, between x0.25 and x2; half as much at 4 m as at 0 m); a round striking near him counts at the distance of its impact; a burst within 1.5 x its stun radius adds up to 0.8. Suppression fades 0.1 per second (tuned with the suppression lab: a fire team at 200 m pins the men it fires at within about 6 s, a machine gun within 1-2 s, at 600 m within about 8 s; one aimed rifle rarely pins). At 0.6 he is pinned (prone, does not move, fires at a third of the rate) until it falls below 0.35. Stress grows by 0.02 per second x suppression, +0.15 for a comrade falling within 60 m, +0.2 when his leader falls, +0.25 x severity for his own wound; experience damps it (x(1 - 0.6 x experience)), his leader within 30 m too (x0.7). Under light fire (suppression below 0.3) it fades 0.01 per second. Stress over 0.3 cautious, 0.55 shaken (fires at 0.7 the rate), 0.85 panicked (lies flat, does not fire) until it is back under 0.7. M4.2 (same terms): a man fires on his own at an enemy he sees within 400 m (rifle), 600 m (magnified sight of 4x or more) or 800 m (machine gun) — under the default rule 'return' only once his unit has been fired upon in the last 30 s (a cease-fire order holds until it is fired upon again); under fire (suppression from 0.1) and not covered from the enemy he knows, he runs to cover within 15 m (preferring a spot where he can fire over it kneeling), at most every 20 s; a man out of spare magazines or belts gets one from the nearest comrade within 30 m who has more than 2 (or carries them for him), handed over in 3 s. M4.3 (owner: panicked men cower; a broken unit runs back): a unit on the move that comes under fire anew halts and takes cover; an assault goes in two halves bounding 30 m at a time (D4a, owner 2026-11-14: rushes of 3-5 s and 15-20 m; now 16 m, about 4.6 s at a run) (one fires at the objective while the other runs, swapping when the runners are down, or after 40 s), the last 25 m all together; a withdrawal bounds back the same way, the halt covering towards the enemy; a unit breaks when half its able men panic: they run 150 m away from the enemy they know and rally once nothing has been fired at them for 30 s (stress x0.6). M5.1 standing rules (owner 2026-11-12): ammunition discipline stretches the time between shots or bursts x1.8 (conserve) or shortens it x0.6 (maximum); 'fall back' on contact withdraws the unit 100 m away from the enemy it knows. Surrender (owner 2026-11-12): a conscious wounded man who can no longer fight (whether or not he can still walk) gives up when an enemy he has seen or been told of in the last 10 s (decisions.contactLostSeconds) is within 50 m and no fit comrade (able, can walk and fight, not panicked or routed) is within 30 m; a panicked or routed man gives up when such an enemy is within 30 m; a fit enemy within 3 m takes a surrendered man prisoner; each man reconsiders once a second. When things are quiet (his unit not fired upon for 10 s), one fit enemy within 50 m who has seen the surrender walks over, takes the man prisoner and returns to where he was; he gives the errand up after 120 s. Walking over (owner 2026-11-14, game values, low): a surrendered man who can walk walks, upright and at 0.6 x a walk, to 2.5 m short of the nearest fit enemy on foot within 80 m whom he knew of or who sees him (one who has seen him give up counts at half his distance), plans afresh when that man moves 4 m, lies down while his suppression is 0.1 or more, and stops after 90 s; meanwhile nobody fetches him. Game values from the owner's approximate distances, the same for every faction; 0 switches a rule off. Attackers (owner 2026-11-12, after M6.6): men of the attacking side, and men of any unit in an assault, do not give up when panicked or routed (they run back instead); a wounded attacker who cannot fight gives up only with a known enemy within 25 m. M7.2 mounting (game values, low): men reach a vehicle exit within 2.5 m and board one at a time per exit; a walk to the exit is re-planned when the hull has moved 3 m; two comrades load a wounded man lying within 5 m of an exit if two able men are within 30 m (owner Q25); boarding is complete when every able man and every loadable casualty is aboard, or 60 s after the first man boarded (300 s at most); men getting out land 3-8 m behind the exit; a withdrawing squad within 100 m of its vehicle gets back in (owner Q24); a squad aboard within 100 m of an objective it is to hold gets out; a man out of spare magazines may take 3 from a halted own vehicle within 30 m, standing within 5 m of an exit; a crew checks once a second whether a crewman must take over a fallen driver or gunner. M7.3 gunnery (game values, low, the same for every side): a crew picks a target once a second among enemies its men saw in the last 4 s or a comrade reported within 20 m in the last 15 s; vehicles first (score x0.3), then men firing (x0.5), nearest first; groups (two or more within 15 m) and men beyond 400 m get high explosive, a single man within 400 m the coaxial machine gun, a vehicle the armour-piercing round; the commander fires the gun when the gunner is out; laser rangefinder 0.5 % range error; halted, a ready belt below a quarter is refilled from stowage; no fire within 60 m of own men on foot; the turret returns to the front 20 s after its last target. Near misses of heavy rounds (12.7 mm and up) suppress up to 4x a rifle round (cap 2 before). Anti-tank (M7.4a, owner Q19/Q20, game values, low): new units fire Panzerfaust and RPG on their own only at enemy vehicles they saw in the last 6 s (men on foot look for vehicles every fourth scan) (vehicles and positions: also at enemies in houses and machine guns; hold: only on an order); range error 5 %, aiming error 2.5 mrad for a regular on top of the round's dispersion; no shot from inside a house unless breached or of at least 60 m2, nor with a wall within 2 m behind or a comrade in the danger zone behind; a comrade within 30 m hands over a rocket. Crews (M7.4a, owner Q14/Q15): a burning vehicle is left 2 s after the fire starts; it burns out (destroyed) after 120 s, its ammunition may cook off every 5 s (8 %); a burning vehicle smokes (8 m); men left inside a vehicle that is destroyed are burnt (severity 0.7-1.0). Reversing out (owner 2026-11-13, "make armour not back out of every fight"; game values, low): a crew reverses out only when penetrated (still mobile), disarmed, its commander panicked, or an enemy man on foot it saw is within 50 m and none of its guns can fire at him; held 15 s, then back to where it stood unless the reason was damage; a bouncing rocket and ordinary infantry fire are no reasons; a vehicle under a player's move or halt order reverses only when penetrated or disarmed. Covering fire (overnight pick 2026-11-14; game values, low, the same for every side): an ordered or drill fire task may end in cover (any obstacle, the ground) up to drills.suppressShortM 15 m short of the point, in the far half of the line, and fires into it at no more than one shot or burst per drills.suppressIntervalS 4 s (a drill's fire at a point with no enemy named likewise); a covering man takes an enemy he knows within drills.coverTargetM 60 m of the objective that he can hit (clear line, no comrade in it), the k-th man starting at the k-th enemy, else one whose cover he can reach, else the objective; every drills.coverRetaskS 2 s a covering man with no shot looks again and, once a bound (drills.sidestep), dashes 2-6 m aside to a spot that gives him one; a runner's bound end is moved aside (at most drills.laneShiftMaxM 10 m, on the side he starts from) to drills.laneClearM 1.5 m outside every covering man's safety cone; the runners of an assault bound go only once a covering man has fired within drills.coverFiredS 5 s, or after drills.coverWaitS 10 s (doctrine 'no move without fire'; 0 switches it off). Defence fall-back (overnight pick 2026-11-14; game value, low): a withdrawal by drills.withdrawTogetherMen 3 able men or fewer goes back to its rally point in one leg, all together, instead of bounding (two men bounding left one lying alone to cover, and the drill took minutes; 0 = always bound). Clearing a house (M7.5e step clear, owner 2026-11-14: suppress the windows, get close, throw a grenade through a window or door, then go in room by room; game values, low, the same for every side): an assault on a building closes in by bounds as any assault, the covering half firing at the enemy it knows in the house, else at its windows facing them; within the last rush it stacks up beside the chosen door (drills.clearStackOffM 1 m off the wall, from drills.clearStackAsideM 1.5 m beside the opening; waiting at most drills.clearStackWaitS 20 s); a man with a hand grenade throws it into the room behind it (from beside the door, else beside a window of that room, else from in front of the door; at most drills.clearThrowWaitS 15 s to get there and throw); drills.clearAfterBurstS 1 s after the burst drills.clearEntryMen 3 men go in, firing as they go, the others follow to the room the throw was made from; then the next room the same way from its doorway (rooms nearest the door first, the ground floor before the stairs, a room with a known enemy first among equals), each room at most drills.clearRoomS 20 s; done when every room was entered, after drills.clearTimeoutS 240 s, or below drills.clearMinMen 3 able men. Review fixes (2026-11-14, low): a grenade is aimed at least drills.clearThrowMinM 4 m from where it is thrown from and where the thrower steps aside to, and not within drills.clearShieldM 3.5 m of a man of the unit who stays in a cleared room; before the throw the others within drills.clearOfM 6 m of the aim point with no wall between (within 3.5 m: a partition or door jamb is no cover) move up to drills.clearMoveAwayM 12 m away into the cleared rooms; aim points drills.clearAimInM 0.9 m in from a room's corners; the stack's men drills.clearStackRankM 1.2 m apart, throw places drills.clearThrowAsideM 0.6 m beside an opening; the entry door scores its distance + drills.clearEntrySeenW 15 per window within drills.clearEntrySeenM 40 m that looks onto it; enemies known within drills.clearKnownS 60 s set the room order; the stack goes on only with a man within drills.clearStackNearM 8 m of the door; a room is entered only by men who can move (with none the drill ends after drills.clearRoomS) and the house is reported clear only with a man of the unit inside it. Night fire discipline (M9.6, game values, low): while the light is below decisions.night.belowLight 0.3 and his platoon has not been fired on within decisions.underFireMemorySeconds, a man opens fire on his own only out to decisions.night.engageRangeM (150 m rifle, 250 m magnified sight, 300 m machine gun; never beyond his day range or his unit's rule) — a muzzle flash gives his place away; fired on, the day ranges apply; vehicles' guns are not affected. Hand smoke (D1, 2026-11-14, game values): a unit ordered to withdraw (the break-contact drill), or ordered to move within smoke.underFireS 10 s of coming under fire, throws one smoke grenade smoke.screenM 15 m from the thrower toward the nearest enemy its men know (known within 30 s, 40-400 m away), at most once in 60 s. MORALE REWORK (owner 2026-11-15: 'morale is almost always at 100'; four driver groups, graded recoverable states, differences by quality, experience, fatigue and leadership, never by nationality): morale = resolve x (1 - shock) x (1 - strain). Shock (mental.stress) is the fast fear: suppression (0.03/s x suppression, and 0.25 x every rise at once), a comrade killed (0.30, incapacitated 0.20; x1 same squad, x0.5 same platoon, x0.25 other; full within 10 m, none beyond 60 m), losses in quick succession (+0.08 each within 60 s), the leader lost (0.25), own wound (0.15 + 0.5 x severity), untreated wounds and comrades left lying, indirect fire within 60 m, enemy armour within 300 m, being outflanked, an enemy close, being alone. Kicks saturate (x += a(1 - x)) and are damped by experience, a leader near (x(1 - 0.5 L)), mates around, cohesion (bond) and good cover. Shock recovers with a time constant of 90 s when quiet, 240 s under light fire, not at all under heavier fire; a near leader, cover, mates and quality speed it. Strain is the slow wear (losses, the leader, wounds; tau 20 min, never below 0.6 x the squad's loss share). Resolve comes from quality (conscript 0.85, regular 0.93, veteran 1.0), the man's nerve, fatigue and heavy squad losses. States: shaken below 0.60 (back at 0.70), pinned by suppression (quality's pin level, 0.15 lower when shaken) or below 0.40 under fire, panicked below 0.25 (held 20 s, back at 0.40): cowering under heavy fire or with an enemy close, else he runs 50-150 m back. A leader rallies (4 s) his worst-off man within 30 m. A unit breaks when half its men panic or its morale stays below 0.3 for 10 s (not in its first 120 s of contact unless it lost a third); a platoon also when half its squads are broken. Sources (search extracts only): Dupuy Institute on suppression and breakpoints (the pace of losses matters more than a percentage), Wong et al. 'Why They Fight' (2003: fighting for one's buddies, trust). All values are game values, tuned in npm run lab -- morale and 10-seed batches. Hesitation (D4b, SPEC 6.6, game values, low, owner to review): an order to move, assault or occupy given to men on foot of whom at least hesitation.shakenShare 0.5 of the able ones are shaken, pinned or panicked is carried out only after hesitation.baseSeconds 3 s + hesitation.perSuppressionSeconds 8 s x their mean suppression (at most hesitation.maxSeconds 10 s), once per order ("moving in a moment"); a later order that moves or stops the same men (move, assault, withdraw, occupy, halt, mount, dismount, defend arc, fire) replaces it, one to part of them ends the wait first; withdrawals, halts, fire and other orders never wait. M11.1 refill: a man refills a spare magazine below half full from loose rounds after 20 s without firing and not under fire, 1.2 s a round by hand and 0.4 s with stripper clips (game values, low: plan section 3 gives 30-60 s a magazine by hand, 10-20 s with clips and a loader, from general knowledge).

fireDistribution.note: Fire distribution (D4b, owner pick (a), game values, low, owner to review): a man with a machine gun or a magnified sight puts his fire on the most dangerous enemy he sees: an enemy machine gun scores x 0.4, an enemy marksman x 0.6, an enemy who fired in the last 3 s a further x 0.5 (lower = more important, on top of the usual nearest-first score); a rifleman spreads his fire: each comrade of his own unit already firing at an enemy (at most 3) makes that enemy score x 1.5.

power.note: Batteries (M11.6, game values, low, owner to review): a battery fitted in a device (radio, goggle, thermal sight) at the start of a battle holds a share of full drawn evenly from [installedMin 0.3, 1] (random stream 'power'; units do not start every fight on fresh batteries; spares start full); a man whose device battery is flat changes it for his fullest spare as soon as he is free (no other action), and in a lull (no fire task, steady or cautious) one below swapBelowShare 0.1 of full, only for a spare holding at least lullSpareShare 0.5 of full and at least a quarter of full more than the fitted one (review fix 2026-11-16: without the margin a man swapped back and forth between part-used batteries).

soldier.note: Individual soldier AI (owner 2026-11-13, packages A-D; game values, low, the same for every side). A: a rifleman down to the magazine in his weapon keeps it as a close-defence reserve: he fires it (aimed) only at an enemy within 100 m, or within 200 m whose unit is assaulting; beyond 200 m riflemen firing on their own fire at half the rate; a man keeps his own target until it is down or he has not seen it for 5 s, unless another scores better than 0.7 x the current one. B: a pinned or panicked man lying where the enemy he knows can see him low-crawls (the crawl movement mode) to the nearest spot within 8 m, not toward the enemy, where it cannot (at most every 10 s); a pinned or panicked man lying in the open (no wall, hedge, building or wood within about 4 m, not indoors) crawls to the nearest spot within 8 m hidden from where the fire comes from (the rounds cracking past him, else the enemy he or his unit knows), else to the nearest such spot or cover feature within 15 m (owner 2026-11-13), never toward the enemy; a pinned man fires back from where he lies; men going to cover or to the end of a move keep 5 m from each other's places; a man on foot within 60 m of an enemy mortar burst remembers the mission (for 90 s after its last burst): halted in the open (no wall, hedge, building or wood within about 4 m) within 35 m of it, he goes into a house within 30 m, else 40 m out of it, not toward the enemy. C: each man remembers the posture of his fire position (where a move, an occupy or a posture order left him: kneeling or standing at a window, lying in the open); once he is no longer pinned and his suppression has faded below 0.05 he takes it again; a man lying where he cannot see the enemy he knows rises to his knees to look (checked every 4 s) and goes down again when fired on; in a fight (the unit fired on in the last 30 s) idle men outdoors turn to face the enemy they know when he is behind their shoulders, and in a team of 3 or more the last man watches the rear (faceEnemy false switches it off, for labs); a squad on its way into a house does not stop on contact; a man with an anti-tank launcher who knows of an enemy vehicle he cannot see (heard, reported, or out of sight, within 20 s and his weapon's range) moves up to 30 m to a spot from which he could see it, at least 40 m from it, preferring its flank or rear, at most every 20 s. D: a man carrying hand grenades throws one on his own (at most every 20 s) at an enemy he knows (seen or reported in the last 30 s) within his throwing range — rising to kneel or stand for the throw as the distance needs — who is behind cover from him (not in his sight) or in a house, when no man of his side is within 10 m of that enemy and no comrade of his unit is already throwing; in the last 50 m of an assault the men on the move fire as they go, at the enemy they know near the objective, with 3 x their aiming error. Fire discipline (overnight pick 2026-11-14): a man firing bursts also holds his fire for a comrade in his safety cone up to 60 m beyond the point he fires at (the beaten zone of a burst; low); a halted man outdoors within 1 m of a man of his side on his level (the higher id moves) steps 2-3 m aside, checked once a second (low); a man raised above his fire position's posture goes back down when his next shot is 3 s or more away, when he reloads, or when no posture gives him a line of fire, and rises again just in time for the next shot, keeping each posture at least 1 s (low). Movement under fire (overnight pick 2026-11-14): a man on a walk or sneak leg whose suppression is at least decisions.seekCoverSuppression (0.1), runs the rest of his way, until 10 s pass without it (low; player orders too); hurryFiredOnSeconds (0 = off, low) would also make every man of a unit with a man under fire in the last that many seconds run (3 s cost the German mounted attack 17/40 -> 10/40 wins); drills.reactNeighbourM (25 m, low): a moving unit also goes to ground when another unit of its platoon within 25 m (centre to centre) comes under fire anew; otherwise only the unit whose own men are fired on reacts to contact. Leaving a house (M7.5e step leave, owner 2026-11-14: men leave a house when it becomes a trap, when the enemy gets inside, or when it is cut off from behind; game values, low; player squads too; houseLeave false = off): a trap is 2 enemy bursts in or on his house (inside its walls or within 1 m outside them) within 30 s, a burst of 0.3 kg of filling or more (a mortar bomb, a rocket) counting 2; the enemy inside is an enemy he or a man of his unit has seen in his house in the last 5 s (one in his own room within 4 m he fights instead); outflanked is an enemy known in the last 10 s within 150 m of the house more than 120 degrees off another enemy his unit remembers (enemies on two sides). Then every man of his unit in that house (and on his way into it) runs out, pinned or not, to a covered spot outdoors 25-50 m from the house within 60 degrees of straight away from the threat, and lies down facing it; his unit's own rules keep it out of that house for 120 s (orders do not); only enemies whose place is known within 25 m (or a quarter of their distance) count: a sound alone places an enemy too vaguely. Review fixes (2026-11-14, low): the spot outdoors is the best cover within soldier.houseLeaveCoverM 8 m of each candidate, each man tries soldier.houseLeaveTries 6 of them, a route costing more than houseLeaveCost[0] 3 x the distance + houseLeaveCost[1] 20 is refused; a unit faces one way in a house (for a trap with no enemy known near) when the mean of its men's window normals is at least soldier.houseFrontMin 0.3 long; a unit that could send nobody out looks again after soldier.houseLeaveRetryS 5 s (and does not report leaving); an order after leaving does not stop the rule (it is looked at afresh); outflanked needs two different enemies. Hiding from drones (M9.6, game values, low): a man on foot who sees an enemy drone within droneHide.triggerM 300 m (horizontally), is not firing at it, has no enemy on the ground in sight to fight and is not under fire (suppression below decisions.seekCoverSuppression) hides from it: on his way he freezes only when it is within freezeTriggerM 120 m (horizontally; nearly overhead: AI drones hover about 220 m from the enemy, and freezing at 300 m cost the German village attack 4/10 -> 0/10 day wins, the Russian 7/10 -> 4/10), for freezeSeconds 20 s, re-armed while he still sees it, never more than maxFreezeSeconds 60 s in a row (then he moves on and does not freeze again for freezeCooldownSeconds 240 s), and never on a bolt out of a house or out of a mortar beaten zone; halted under a tree canopy (vegetation over him higher than spotting.drone.canopyAboveM) or indoors he lies down where he is; halted in the open he runs (mode) to the nearest canopy within searchM 40 m and lies there, while the drone is still at least moveBeyondM 100 m off horizontally (closer he lies down where he is), else lies down where he is; a man at a post (busy with an action, of a mortar or missile team that is not packed, flying a drone) never goes to a canopy, he lies down where he is; once the drone is gone he takes his fire position's posture again and, if he went to a canopy and is still there, walks back to his place (drone lab: sneaking 30 m to a wood under a drone at 100 m got him spotted sooner than standing still, median 5 s against 18 s; running there cut the share spotted within 60 s from 20/20 to 11/20); he stays down until hideSeconds 30 s after he last saw it, and looks for a canopy again no sooner than that (triggerM 0 = off). Close-range fire (sight realism step 2, owner 2026-11-15: 'an enemy right in front should be seen and engaged'; game values, low, in line with the immediate-action drill 'react to contact: return fire, get down', search extracts only): under rule 'return', a man not fired on lately still opens fire on his own at an enemy he sees (not spared) within decisions.returnCloseM 100 m (in the dark no farther than the night ranges); a moving unit goes to ground when one of its men sees an enemy anew within drills.reactSeenM 150 m (drills.reactSeenNightM 75 m in the dark), as when fired on; a man running, in an assault or on a push fires on the move at an enemy he sees within soldier.moveEngageM 75 m; a pinned man (not panicked) fires, lying, at an enemy he sees within soldier.pinnedSelfDefenceM 50 m; an enemy he sees within soldier.closeThreatM 40 m in his front arc is fired at whatever else he is doing (an errand, care, which waits; a drill's or an order's fire at a point more than closeThreatTaskFactor 2 x farther). Hold, a cease-fire, an ambush not yet sprung, a unit's range limit and a defend arc still hold. Sight realism step 4 (2026-11-15; game values, low: individual movement techniques - observe from a new position, move to a firing point with a view - from search extracts of FM 3-21.8 style manuals only): peek: a halted man, not pinned and not firing, who knows an enemy (seen or reported within 60 s, at most 20 m off, within his engage range) but has seen no enemy for 4 s looks for him once every 15 s: he turns to him (out of a fight, his platoon not fired on within 30 s, only within turnMaxDeg 90 degrees of his facing); kneels if that clears the line; else stands for 3 s if that does, no fire is near him and he is not in a fight (his platoon fired on, rounds past him or that enemy firing, all within 30 s; standInFight false; review fix 2026-11-16), then takes the posture he stood up from again; else crawls (or walks, if not lying) to the least exposed spot 2, 4 or 6 m across the line, measured from where his looks began, that sees him. windowSwitch: indoors, after 6 s without seeing an enemy, he runs to another window of his house that sees the enemy (plants and smoke leaving at least minView 0.1 of the view) and that no comrade holds or is going to (of the 3 nearest, a storey counting storeyWeight 2 times its height, the shortest way), at most every 20 s. Neither for a man at a post (an action, a mortar or missile team not packed, a drone). Suppressive fire at a known place (M11.1, slice 43 point 7b): the rule exists (soldier.suppressKnown: withinS, intervalS, mgIntervalS, minM, maxErrM) but is OFF (absent here): measured with withinS 30, intervalS 4, mgIntervalS 4.5, maxErrM 40 it raised the defenders' rate little and in hold-resupply seed 2 the German defenders fired 364 rounds at known places without a hit (22 hits without it) and lost in 453 s; see DECISIONS 'M11.1'.

consolidate.note: M11.2 (slice 44; game values, low; the owner's answers 2026-11-16 'taking kit' and 'no ammunition at the red cross'). Consolidation (the 'redistribute ammunition' step of consolidation and reorganisation in infantry manuals; search extracts only, no figures): a squad not fired on for 60 s and halted for 20 s (not on the march) evens out its able men's ammunition, looked at every 2 s, at most 2 hand-overs at once, between men within 50 m: belts first (a machine gunner below 2 spare belts gets one from a man carrying belts), then magazines (no man 2 or more spare magazines above another), then packages of loose rounds (2 or more). Own casualties: once treated (a treatment done and nothing more the line can do) or dead, the nearest able man of his squad within 30 m who is low (below 3 spare magazines, or a gunner's belts), else the man who treated him if the squad's mean is below 3, takes his magazines, belts, loose rounds, grenades and rockets in 8 s, leaving a man who can still use his arms 1 magazine. At the Verwundetennest the nearest able man of his platoon within 30 m (not a man with the red cross) takes it, else it is left in a pile 30 m from the nest. 'Take enemy kit' (player order only): a man within 150 m goes and takes it in 10 s. The men who walked over for a hand-over or a taking walk back to where they stood.
